page.overview:
Who is San Bakar?

Professor San Bakar (fl. 1470s) was a wizard from Yemen that lived during the Tudor period. At one point, he was the professor of Beasts at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.

San Bakar was born in the country of Yemen. He left his Muggle community when he learned of his magical abilities, and eventually found his way to Great Britain to study at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, where he was sorted into Slytherin house. Following his graduation, he became the Beasts professor.

San Bakar was a contemporary of Percival Rackham, Niamh Fitzgerald, and Charles Rookwood—and together, the four of them founded the Keepers, an organisation dedicated to the preservation of ancient magic, which they used for benevolent purposes but also kept secret so that nobody could exploit its power.

He was a teacher at the time that Isidora Morganach was a student, and when Morganach graduated and became a professor herself, San Bakar was present as the Keepers mentored her.
